Admit Cards Released for UGC NET and Other Exams

Admit cards for the UGC NET June 2026 re-examination have been released by the National Testing Agency (NTA). The re-exam is scheduled for September 9 and 10 for candidates appearing in English, Commerce, or Sociology subjects. Over 1.5 lakh candidates are awaiting their hall tickets. Admit cards for other examinations, including UPSC CDS-II, UPSC NDA-II, CSBC Constable GD PST/DV, and UPCISB, have also been issued. Candidates can download their respective admit cards from the official websites.
